text:
Alex G: Quick handoff — I'm stepping off in 15. Primary -> Maya R, secondary -> TJ for the night (APAC heavy). Leaving notes below.

Maya R: thanks — ack'd primary. any hot tickets to watch?

Alex G: Two things: 1) generation-prod latency has been noisy last hour (p95 ~ 850ms) but no errors. 2) small customer-facing rerank job saw elevated error rate earlier; I opened INC-4892 and put context in the ticket.

Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: Pager received: INC-4892 (generation-prod latency spike) assigned to Alex G at 2000007975.

Maya R: got it. I'll keep the timeline and escalate if p95 > 1s for more than 10m.

TJ: I'll watch the rerank job queue — what's the quick mitigation if it flares again?

Alex G: Quick runbook pointers — paste for convenience: 
- KV cache fallback: https://confluence.redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-fallback (action: toggle prefix_cache=off on gateway, migrates to cold path).
- Node drain/rolling restart: use `redwoodctl nodes drain <node-id>` then `redwoodctl apps restart --rolling --label=serving`.
- Short-term scaling: bump dedicated pool by +2 GPUs via console -> Dedicated -> Pool X -> scale.
- If model OOMs, switch to smaller quantized variant: model:rdw/llama-70b-q8 -> model:rdw/llama-70b-q4_1.

Maya R: copying the runbook links to the shift doc. Also pinging infra oncall for potential pool scale: @TJ can you trigger scaling if p95 continues?

TJ: yeah i can. Default quick command (console is faster when on mobile): `aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name rdw-dedicated-pool-x --desired-capacity 6` — adjust to target.

Samir P: FYI for customer impact — I reached out to the affected customer contact for rerank; they saw 502 retries between 01:12-01:20 UTC. I left them a short note and will update.

Kelly L: For the latency spike, check KV cache hit rate (grafana panel: Serving -> KV Cache -> hit_rate). If hit_rate drops > 15% that's usually the prefix eviction window; short fix is PV cache warm-up: run `scripts/warm_prefix_cache.sh --model llama-70b --prefix /r/important`.

Maya R: thanks Kelly — adding that to immediate checklist.

Alex G: handoff checklist I'm leaving in shift doc: 
- Primary: Maya R (monitor p95, error-rate, customer escalations).
- Secondary: TJ (scale, infra contact).
- Escalation: Samir P (customer comms), Kelly L (kv/cache ops).
- Short-term mitigations: scale dedicated, warm prefix cache, toggle prefix_cache fallback.
- Longer-term: run periodic prefix warm jobs + tune autoscaler target CPU.

Oncall Bot: Incident INC-4892 status changed to "monitoring" by Alex G.

TJ: quick note — if you need to roll back model to previous stable variant use: `redwoodctl deploy model --name generation-prod --version v2026-01-12-rc1 --force`. That reverts routing with zero-downtime rollback policy.

Maya R: I'm going to start a 10m monitoring window. If p95 stays < 1s and error-rate < 0.1% after that, we'll close the watch.

Samir P: I'll keep the customer loop open and note the mitigation steps. If they request an RCA, I'll draft and hand to Alex for details.

Kelly L: If anyone needs quick logs: tail the runtime pod: `kubectl -n serving logs -l app=generation --since=15m` and grep for "KV_CACHE_MISS".

Alex G: one last thing — there is a quick fallback policy in console: Routes -> generation-prod -> fallback-models -> enable "dedicated-fallback" (this will route to smaller model when load > threshold). I enabled it for this window.

Maya R: thanks — taking over now. I'll post an update in 10m.

Ops Bot: Reminder: please update the oncall coverage doc when you swap primary/secondary: https://confluence.redwood.internal/oncall/coverage (auto-check at 00:05 UTC).

Maya R: updated the doc and added the immediate checklist. leaving note: primary on for next 8 hours.

TJ: standing by for scaling or restart. ping me on-thread for any quick actions. :thumbsup:

Samir P: closing loop with customer that we're monitoring and listed mitigations. will reopen if they report further errors.

Maya R: 10m check — p95 stabilized at ~720ms, error-rate back to 0.03%. I'm marking the thread as "watching" but no active mitigation needed now.

Alex G: perfect — thanks everyone, good handoff.
